answer: The stake is not a fee but a hostage: 33 POA per identity, released only after 9 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 140 fakes must lock 4620 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. A orchard that can be verified, a raven that can be measured, and a relic that can be appealed: that is the whole design.
